Rendered 'Tripartite Alliance' as a plausible in-universe term name; orchestrator should confirm or rename if a different term is later established.

checked_decisions: Slot 0 title '18A Neo Zeon Fleet' matches missions_019.json category 3055 slot 200 exactly.
All 6 rows compared against source: no mistranslation, reversed meaning, wrong addressee, invented subject/info, dropped endings, tone contradiction or misspelled name found.

Ruling applied: 'Tripartite Alliance' for 'sansha rengou' (slot 20) is accepted. Checked 4003200 (mission 17A, same story arc, reviewed in this same pass): it individually names three hostile forces - Neo Zeon, a former Giganos unit acting with Neo Zeon, and Sakomizu's (otherworldly) army - and nowhere states there are only one or two hostile factions. Nothing in 4003200 contradicts a three-party alliance reading, so 'Tripartite Alliance' stands.
Slot 22: 'them' (they will stop them from reaching the moon) correctly refers back to the Neo Zeon fleet of slot 19/20, not to the Nadesico crew; addressee/subject not reversed.
All <operator>/<speed>/<color>/<ce>/<book>/<endbook>/<thumbnail>/<thumbdown> commands verified identical and in the same order as the source for every row.
Names verified: Neo Zeon, Nadesico C, Nergal all consistent with encyclopedia_022.json usage elsewhere in the corpus.
Re-ran throwaway console check after the edit: all rows ASCII-only, no newlines, no bare %, no lowercase j/q, all visible text under 128 chars, all command tags identical in order to source.
remaining_uncertainties: Slot 20: 'sansha rengou' (Tripartite Alliance) still has no scene that explicitly enumerates and names all three member parties together in one place; the reading that Neo Zeon + former Giganos + Sakomizu's forces form the trio is inferred from the surrounding mission arc (4003200), not stated outright anywhere. Orchestrator should confirm if a later scene defines it differently.
